ra.thoracolumbar-fractures.label: CT-derived vertebrae · T1–L5
ra.thoracolumbar-fractures.population_note: Whole-vertebra source labels from one CT case, T1–L5. Normality, pathology and separately reportable substructures remain unverified. This CT case is independent of the MRI cord/dura reference; their coordinates must not be combined.

source_volume.title: Inspect matching source CT planes · T1–L5
source_volume.caption: Stored CT sample spacing: 0.68 × 0.68 × 1.0 mm. Source acquisition slice thickness: 1.5 mm. Sample spacing does not establish effective anatomical resolution; fine endplates, cortices and facets remain unverified. Native CT crops spanning each supplied vertebral label and its margin. Select level, plane and slice; adjust the CT window and original-label overlay. These crops do not establish whole-examination or soft-tissue completeness.

ra.thoracolumbar-fractures.population_note: Partial cord and dural contour envelopes from MRI source case sub-03. Their endpoints and interpolation assumptions limit anatomical coverage. Assess conus, cauda equina, roots and compression interfaces separately using the acquired images.

ra.brain-anatomy.label: Putamen and pallidal segments · population reference
ra.brain-anatomy.population_note: Partial adult population reference: bilateral putamen and internal/external pallidal segments only. Original MNI2009b coordinates; independent of BodyParts3D. Clinical boundary accuracy and fine lamina anatomy remain unverified.

source_image.title: Source quantitative MRI and direct model sections
source_image.alt: Native AHEAD group MRI in R1, R2-star and susceptibility contrasts, with direct joint-model section lines for bilateral putamen and pallidal segments.
source_image.caption: Adult group templates, not individual clinical MRI. Twelve median panels: axial, coronal and bilateral sagittal source sections in three quantitative contrasts. Coloured lines intersect the exported joint models directly. Atlas: 97 adults; MRI templates: 105 adults. No fitted alignment or source resampling. Subvoxel interfaces are derived and clinical anatomical accuracy remains unverified.

ra.brain-anatomy.label: Whole-brain context · BodyParts3D
ra.brain-anatomy.population_note: Existing adult male whole-hemisphere, cerebellar and ventricular reference. Gyri, capsule limbs and deep nuclei are not independently resolved. This source is separate from the MNI population reference; their coordinates must not be combined.

ra.vascular-anomalies.label: Bilateral-SVC MRI source blood pools · partial
ra.vascular-anomalies.population_note: Partial blood-pool reference from one adult MRI case (pat7, age 27), source-described bilateral SVC. It is not a normal whole-heart atlas or the anatomy of the patient being reported. Eight source classes only. LA includes limited source pulmonary-vein extents; SVC combines both source channels. Vessel endpoints and class junctions follow segmentation conventions, including benchmark optional zones, not complete clinical anatomy. Thin valves, myocardium/vessel walls, complete venous branches and drainage interfaces, coronary sinus, ductal/ligamentous ring and airway anatomy are not independently represented. The original small RV component is retained.

ra.mri-sinuses.label: Regional CT source label interfaces · partial
ra.mri-sinuses.population_note: One regional source CT case (P001); patient age and native DICOM orientation are not independently verified. These are five original region-label interfaces, not a complete sinonasal atlas or the anatomy of the patient being reported. The source grid is 153×205×52 with declared 0.586×0.586×1.5 mm sampling. This does not establish operative thin-bone effective resolution, raw DICOM/HU lineage or full head coverage. Both original left nasal-cavity components and 98 open nasal-pharynx edges at the acquired boundary are retained. Viewer rotation or uncropped framing cannot restore anatomy outside the scan. Frontal/ethmoid/sphenoid cells, full drainage routes, bone/mucosal thickness, optic/carotid/nerve/vessel boundaries and lesion or extrasinus extension are not independently represented.

ra.ct-temporal-bone.label: Prepared temporal-bone specimen surfaces · partial
ra.ct-temporal-bone.population_note: One prepared adult cadaveric temporal-bone specimen, ZETA. Thirteen source surfaces only; this is not a full normal atlas or the anatomy of the patient being reported. Original 7,349,910 triangles retained, including two zero-area Bone faces. Source surface optimization/segmentation conventions do not independently delineate every tiny wall, joint, neural branch, implant or pathological interface. Source coordinate convention is RAS, reconciled with recorded volume declarations and crop offset. Patient anatomical directions and laterality are not independently verified; camera controls use specimen-coordinate labels. Microscopy shows fixed, stained, dehydrated, epoxy-embedded tissue. A preparation opening was drilled in the superior semicircular canal. The original photograph is not untreated living-ear colour or functional evidence.
